name: post-office-next
description: Isolated contracts, legacy capture, deterministic migration replay, and recovery tooling for the next Codex Comms control plane.

interface.longDescription: Post Office Next provides versioned contracts, read-only legacy capture, isolated deterministic import and event replay, local content-addressed retention, and verified backup/restore. It does not mutate or replace the live Codex Comms service.
defaultPrompt: Inspect the Post Office Next contracts.
Rehearse a deterministic Post Office migration in an isolated destination.
